title: Ask Anything! Meet ORB HAUS, the Visual Wizards Behind Your Favorite K-pop Universes
content:
Ever wondered how the breathtaking visuals in your favorite K-pop MVs come to life? 🌌

From the high-octane energy of Stray Kids to the futuristic aesthetics of aespa, **the creative minds at ORB HAUS** are here to answer YOUR questions!

![cbc0eeb35a8342789e5750ce537216a0](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/f32aceea8d504154b50d83521600268b/images/cbc0eeb35a8342789e5750ce537216a0Selected%20February%2012%202026%2010.png)![f4801243874c4c70bbb374e8103bc859](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/f32aceea8d504154b50d83521600268b/images/f4801243874c4c70bbb374e8103bc859Selected%20February%2012%202026%2051.png)![732e3da3762a41778f48a6bd0b71a1c9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/f32aceea8d504154b50d83521600268b/images/732e3da3762a41778f48a6bd0b71a1c9Selected%20February%2012%202026%2038.png)

* * *

# **🎬 About ORB HAUS**

ORB HAUS is a global creative studio and VFX/CG-based **Art-Tech company** that turns imagination into reality.  
They have been setting new standards for **K-VFX** , building the music videos and expansive universes for top-tier artists like **Stray Kids, aespa, and SEVENTEEN.**

Beyond the traditional frame, ORB HAUS is evolving into a next-generation storytelling company. Their work spans from surreal landscapes to **immersive 360° XR spaces** , focusing on XR-based world-building, new media formats, and original IP development.

![96f211edf61544718aca1e6b51eb4c9f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/f32aceea8d504154b50d83521600268b/images/96f211edf61544718aca1e6b51eb4c9fSelected%20February%2012%202026%20284.png)**“Spread peace through art and tech.”**  
Under this mission, ORB HAUS blurs the lines between gaming and music content, designing artist universes and presenting new possibilities for immersive entertainment.

* * *

# **👤 ZADDICTED (Gwan-deok Ji) | Co-founder of ORB HAUS | VFX Supervisor | Cinematic Artist**

ZADDICTED is the co-founder of ORB HAUS and a Seoul-based **VFX Supervisor & Cinematic Artist** with over 10 years of experience. A key figure in the global K-pop MV industry, his work—powered by **Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, and After Effects** —focuses on refining imaginary concepts into a realistic cinematic language.

Currently, he is researching new forms of visual content that merge narrative with sensory experience, integrating **Motion Capture and 360 XR technology** within ORB HAUS’s original sci-fi cinematic universe.

  * **Major Projects:** Accumulated extensive experience in technical directing and production for global artists and brands, including **BTS, Stray Kids, aespa, Enhypen, and Samsung Galaxy Unpacked.**

  * **🔗 See More Work:**[[instagram.com/orb.haus](http://instagram.com/orb.haus)]

title: MATRIX - CALCULATED ESCAPE: Bridging MetaHuman, Marvelous Designer, and AI Sequences
content:
## _MATRIX - CALCULATED ESCAPE: Precision Tailoring meets AI_[ _Jaehee Wang_](https://www.behance.net/gallery/242316663/MATRIX-CALCULATED-ESCAPE) _synchronizes MetaHuman and Marvelous Designer to create a foundation of structural realism. This 3D precision acts as a strategic anchor for an AI sequence pipeline, using Unreal Engine renders to ensure absolute character consistency while redefining the limits of modern cinematic storytelling._

* * *

# _[_**_Artist Introduction]_**_  
_**Could you start with a brief introduction of yourself?**

![044863126e924585900d2811dd1f3ba9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/f4917773e6cb402fb58520705b842f51/images/044863126e924585900d2811dd1f3ba9image.png) Hello. I am a creator specializing in 3D motion graphics and AI video production. Utilizing Cinema 4D as my primary tool alongside various other software, I focus on visual expression through characters, environments, and movement.

My background in industrial and product design involved balancing high-quality results with practical constraints like unit costs, materials, and mass production. While this taught me the importance of structural design thinking, I found myself drawn to the 3D environment, where I can convey messages more freely and intuitively through form and motion.

Currently, I am exploring character-based cinematic compositions with a focus on planning and directing, while integrating **AI-** driven video pipelines into my workflow. I continue to develop personal projects with the goal of creating work where technology and art direction connect seamlessly.

#   
**_[About the MATRIX - CALCULATED ESCAPE]_**  
**Your project ‘MATRIX - CALCULATED ESCAPE’ is incredibly impressive. Could you tell us more about it?**

**MATRIX - CALCULATED ESCAPE** is a cinematic video project that reinterprets systems operating without human awareness through the metaphor of a Matrix-style virtual world. Inspired by the worldview and structural narrative presented in the film _The Matrix_ , this project sought to unravel an individual's process of perceiving and attempting to escape the system using a more restrained visual language.

In this project, I aimed to visually reveal the concepts of **systemic rules, surveillance, and repetition** through a structure where the character's emotions and movements become increasingly restricted. I designed the piece so that viewers gradually experience the cracks and control inherent in the system through the use of **glitches, noise, and repetitive screen staging.**

The narrative follows this specific flow:

  * **The Red Pill:** Symbolizes the choice to perceive reality.

  * **Distorted Messages and TV Screens:** Symbolize surveillance and replicated rules.

  * **The Telephone (Exit Signal):** Functions as the final signal required to exit the system.




Ultimately, "escape" is portrayed not as an impulsive act, but as a process of breaking free through **calculated choices** and systemic awareness. The project focuses on the structural tension where cracks gradually emerge within a controlled order.

# _[_**_Character Design]_**  
**The characters in the MATRIX project are deeply impressive due to their realistic expression and restrained movement. Could you explain the detailed workflow you used to create these characters using MetaHuman and Marvelous Designer?**

![fff7e817e3fa40c48d0ec87e2b5f9d26](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/f4917773e6cb402fb58520705b842f51/images/fff7e817e3fa40c48d0ec87e2b5f9d2604_MD_Simulation-ezgif.com-video-to-webp-converter.webp) The characters in this project were designed with the goal of embodying **realistic human forms** paired with a **composed, resilient image**. To achieve this, I utilized MetaHuman and Marvelous Designer, assigning specific roles to each tool.

### 1\. Character Prototyping (MetaHuman)

I began by constructing the character's base form in **MetaHuman** , focusing primarily on body proportions and skin details. I carefully adjusted the facial balance and nuances to maintain a restrained, stoic impression rather than using exaggerated expressions.

### 2\. Costume Design (Marvelous Designer)

Next, I crafted the clothing using **Marvelous Designer**.

  * **Process:** I imported the MetaHuman body (stripping away decorative elements) and designed patterns based on a silhouette optimized for movement and a close-fitting structure.

  * **Styling:** I applied a **corset-style garment** over a neutral leather jacket to cinch the waistline. This specific look was intended to reinforce the character’s identity and "agent-like" persona.




### 3\. Simulation & Integration (Unreal Engine)

Once the garment production was complete, I established the character's posture in **Unreal Engine** based on a standard A-pose. I then ran the cloth simulation to reflect that specific pose accurately.

### 4\. Final Look Development

The final step involved applying textures to the simulated clothing and fine-tuning the **camera composition and lighting** simultaneously. This integrated approach allowed me to complete the main style frames with a high degree of visual cohesion.

![0e16346742604614b71ef7bfb628c379](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/f4917773e6cb402fb58520705b842f51/images/0e16346742604614b71ef7bfb628c37907_Final_StyleFrame_03.png)

#   
**_[AI Sequence Production Process]_  
You mentioned that you developed AI sequences based on your character designs. Could you walk us through the overall workflow of how these AI sequences were produced?**

In my experience, the greatest advantage of an **AI sequence workflow** is the ability to generate high-density images and videos in a short amount of time, provided the planning intent is clear.

For this project, rather than starting with AI from scratch, I chose to **expand upon my own pre-designed character assets.** This ensured that the concept and character details remained consistent throughout the process.

### **The Workflow:**

  1. **Reference Setting:** I used the main style frames rendered in **Unreal Engine** as the base reference images for AI generation.

  2. **Guided Generation:** Depending on the scene's requirements, I generated background elements, special effects, and various character angles. To ensure the AI recognized the output as the same individual, I fed it a dataset of the character's full body, close-ups, and multiple angles that I had personally created.

  3. **Refinement & Compositing:** After deriving numerous drafts, I used **Photoshop** to iteratively recombine and retouch the images.

  4. **Cohesion & Motion:** Once the stills were finalized, I unified the color grade and tone across the entire sequence. Finally, I designed motion prompts tailored to the project’s plan to generate video clips, then adjusted the pacing and duration to complete the final sequence.




#   
**_[Experience with Marvelous Designer]_**  
**What was the most impressive feature or experience you had while using Marvelous Designer?**

![bf6d4645adc04f8d915d2ffd4c9d7308](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/f4917773e6cb402fb58520705b842f51/images/bf6d4645adc04f8d915d2ffd4c9d7308image.png) The most striking aspect of using **Marvelous Designer** was that it shifted my perspective: I wasn't just "modeling" clothes; I was thinking about them in terms of **structure and physical properties.**

In traditional 3D tools, I was accustomed to creating a shape first and then adding details on top. However, because Marvelous Designer is based on **patterns and tailoring structures** , I was able to create organic, flowing garments with much greater freedom.

![1a5b255b069145a9beb5dfe66937d002](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/f4917773e6cb402fb58520705b842f51/images/1a5b255b069145a9beb5dfe66937d00203_MD_PatternLayout.png)  
Specific highlights of the experience include:

  * **Real-time Iteration:** I found it incredibly efficient that even a minor tweak to a pattern was immediately reflected through the simulation.

  * **Visual Intuition:** The ability to instantly verify the silhouette, the direction of wrinkles, and how tightly the fabric fits the body—visually rather than through numerical values—is a massive advantage.




Within the overall workflow, I felt Marvelous Designer acted as the **pivotal stage for character polish.** By realistically draping garments over the body built in MetaHuman, I was able to elevate the character's sense of realism and overall quality to the next level.

#   
**_[Scalability: Marvelous Designer × Unreal / MetaHuman]_   
Marvelous Designer is expanding various connectivity features with Unreal Engine (UE) such as**[**LiveSync, USD data export for garments**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358145573401--Tips-Tricks-Discover-Better-Workflow-with-Marvelous-Designer-and-Unreal-Engine)**, and the**[**MetaHuman Importer**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/ko/articles/51752244831897-MetaHuman-DNA-Importer?_gl=1*ttivkp*_gcl_au*NDM3MDIwNTc3LjE3NjkwNDYzNTQ.*_ga*NTYzODc1MzI2LjE3NDM1MzYzMDk.*_ga_H0HZ87YP5G*czE3Njk0NzUxOTgkbzI0MCRnMSR0MTc2OTQ3NTIxNSRqNDMkbDAkaDE2MDE1MjgyNzk.)**. If you are planning future projects using Marvelous Designer, in what directions would you like to expand your work using these connectivity features?**

I am particularly interested in projects where the **organic movement and physical properties** of clothing are expressed more dynamically. Specifically, I would like to experiment with **traditional Korean attire (Hanbok)** , which emphasizes the flow of fabric and complex layered structures.

Moving forward, I want to leverage the integration between **Marvelous Designer and Unreal Engine** to continuously explore ways to naturally render the motion and texture of garments within a cinematic environment.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to showcase "MATRIX - CALCULATED ESCAPE," a groundbreaking 3D cinematic project that merges precision tailoring with AI technology to explore themes of systemic control and personal liberation through innovative character design and storytelling.

title: Introducing the Marvelous Designer Academic Certification Program
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/26c14580d4d8456e95db7c6b0495dc74/images/c54c157a497c46a68e8a4cbd013ee7da26AcademicCert_Black_OR_Border.png)![b78ff3ab6de44fcfa95af90a264e4128](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/26c14580d4d8456e95db7c6b0495dc74/images/b78ff3ab6de44fcfa95af90a264e412826AcademicCert_Black_OR_Border.png)

As part of our ongoing commitment to education, we’re introducing the **Marvelous Designer Academic Certification Program** , a new initiative designed to recognize institutions that meet our standards for teaching using Marvelous Designer.

The certification program supports schools that integrate Marvelous Designer into their curriculum in a structured, professional, and industry-aligned way. Certified institutions demonstrate a clear commitment to preparing students for real-world workflows using Marvelous Designer.

Certification focuses on curriculum alignment, instructional quality, and meaningful use of Marvelous Designer within academic programs. Our goal is not only to recognize existing excellence, but also to create a shared standard that benefits students, educators, and the broader industry.

The program is launching with an initial focus on Europe, allowing us to work closely with academic partners in the region as we refine the framework and lay the foundation for long-term educational resources.

We completed our first academic certification with Lightbox Academy**** in Spain, marking an important milestone for the program. It was a pleasure working with their team throughout the process, and we’re excited to continue expanding the certification initiative with additional institutions across Europe.

[_LINKEDIN POST_](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7425583276507000832)

We’re excited to congratulate Lightbox Academy on becoming the first institution to complete the Marvelous Designer Academic Certification! This initiative recognizes institutions that integrate Marvelous Designer into their industry-aligned curriculum through a formal recognition program.

It was a pleasure working closely with their team throughout the process, and we look forward to continuing our support of academic partners across Europe.
content_description: The Marvelous Designer Academic Certification Program aims to recognize and support institutions that effectively integrate Marvelous Designer into their curriculum, ensuring students are prepared for industry standards and real-world workflows.

title: Finding Beauty within Repair - AI / Kimia's work for MDCC Vol.3
content:
## _Iranian designer_[ _AI / Kimia_](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/403448/info) _discusses her journey on creating her entry for the_[ _Marvelous Designer Creator’s Contest 2025 Vol.3_](https://connect.clo-set.com/contest/mdcc2025vol3) _, titled_[ _"Puppeteer: Tokyo Evolution,"_](https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/7a79dd1cbfd54f7f84419883f7cd28f1)_serving as a case study in blending cultural philosophy with technical precision and winning the Community Choice award._  
_By applying the Japanese concept of Kintsugi—the art of finding beauty in repair—Kimia explores through tradition and imagination, strength, and rebirth within the creation of digital garment._

![3D Creator's_Contest_AI_Fantasy_Avant_Garde Model](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/marketplace/202510/7a79dd1cbfd54f7f84419883f7cd28f1/1/thumbnail/07-6-2.jpg?resize=1&f=webp&w=960&h=1280&fit=cover)[Puppeteer: Tokyo Evolution](https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/7a79dd1cbfd54f7f84419883f7cd28f1)

* * *

# **Artist Introduction: please tell us about yourself.**

Hello world,

My name is Kimia, and I am from Iran. I can’t say that I am fully a digital fashion designer yet—but I am a designer, and I am actively finding my path toward that point.

My creative journey began in architecture, where I learned to think in terms of structure, balance, an. My creative journey began in architecture, a discipline that taught me how to think in terms of structure, balance, and spatial logic. Over time, I realized that alongside this structural approach, I am deeply drawn to storytelling, emotion, and meaning in design.

Participating in the Marvelous Designer Creator’s Contest was both challenging and deeply rewarding. My main motivation for joining was to move beyond purely technical execution and focus on concept, symbolism, and personal expression. This contest gave me the freedom to experiment while still working within a professional framework.

[![b0f4a51652b249b0a7aef141d3c8c9c3](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/52b36810290548fca188cb73ffa60435/images/b0f4a51652b249b0a7aef141d3c8c9c3%E7%94%BB%E5%83%8F1.jpg)](https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/7a79dd1cbfd54f7f84419883f7cd28f1)

Through this experience, I learned that digital fashion can function as a powerful narrative medium rather than simply a visual outcome. I also learned to trust the design process, embrace imperfections, and allow the garment to evolve organically—mirroring my own growth as a designer.

![cb5b49af98634ef5bbe2ef5514caba06](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/52b36810290548fca188cb73ffa60435/images/cb5b49af98634ef5bbe2ef5514caba06gandr-collage%20%2838%29.jpg)

* * *

# **We’d like to hear more about the art direction in your Creator’s contest 2025 Vol.3. What was the visual style you were aiming for?**

In Puppeteer: Tokyo Evolution, my goal was to create a visual language that exists between eras, cultures, and emotional states. The core inspiration comes from Kintsugi, the Japanese philosophy of embracing fracture and repair as part of an object’s beauty and strength.

![ea0100bafae5409d953f510cd1700cbf](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/52b36810290548fca188cb73ffa60435/images/ea0100bafae5409d953f510cd1700cbfgandr-collage%20%2834%29.jpg)

Visually, I wanted the garment to feel ceremonial yet rebellious. Traditional Japanese kimono elements were deconstructed and reinterpreted through an avant-garde lens, with subtle influences from Victorian silhouettes. Voluminous sleeves, a rigid sculptural collar, and layered fabrics create a tension between softness and control, while the lifted skirt symbolically suggests liberation.

![c12881d4d1244b35aedab75b4f709a22](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/52b36810290548fca188cb73ffa60435/images/c12881d4d1244b35aedab75b4f709a22gandr-collage%20%2840%29.jpg)

The parasol-like hat adorned with delicate chains conveys a sense of balance between fragility and strength. The puppeteer and bird motifs represent the relationship between guidance and freedom. The divided white and blue background symbolizes sky and flight, transforming the scene into a poetic moment of transition and rebirth.

  
![65c40142ac194afd85068e64d43a5d74](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/52b36810290548fca188cb73ffa60435/images/65c40142ac194afd85068e64d43a5d74gandr-collage%20%2835%29.jpg)

* * *

# **Would you be able to give us a quick overview of the different tools you use in your pipeline with a focus on Marvelous Designer?****  
****Have you encountered any challenges and how have you overcome them?**

Marvelous Designer played a central role in my workflow and served as the foundation of the entire project. I began by building the base silhouette and patterns directly in Marvelous Designer, with a strong focus on proportions, fabric behavior, weight, and layering.

![4c7e81930b0e491dbc48e6a45b1c0327](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/52b36810290548fca188cb73ffa60435/images/4c7e81930b0e491dbc48e6a45b1c0327Screenshot%20%283%29%20-%20Copy%20-%20Copy.png)

![c25a61062213415686e74b0db2c3842a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/52b36810290548fca188cb73ffa60435/images/c25a61062213415686e74b0db2c3842agandr-collage%20%2842%29.jpg)

The kimono structure, sleeves, and layered skirt were developed using traditional pattern logic, which I intentionally disrupted by adjusting tensions, shortening panels, and lifting sections of the garment to create a more expressive and unconventional form.

![6ef1c41789f343e5b9444cca05b1ac5f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/52b36810290548fca188cb73ffa60435/images/6ef1c41789f343e5b9444cca05b1ac5fgandr-collage%20%2843%29.jpg)

One of the main challenges was maintaining visual clarity while working with highly layered and voluminous elements. I addressed this by breaking the process into clear stages, refining each component individually, and continuously evaluating balance and cohesion so the final garment felt dynamic rather than static.

![cd27b9ff46404a91a858f5c020677aec](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/52b36810290548fca188cb73ffa60435/images/cd27b9ff46404a91a858f5c020677aecgandr-collage%20%2837%29.jpg)

![f19997a5686b4b0790b5317e1efe5133](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/52b36810290548fca188cb73ffa60435/images/f19997a5686b4b0790b5317e1efe5133gandr-collage%20%2839%29.jpg)

* * *

# **Are there any tips and tricks with Marvelous Designer that you can share with the community?**

My main advice is to approach Marvelous Designer as a creative design space rather than only a simulation tool. Allow the fabric to guide you.

Experiment with internal lines, tension, and early-stage imperfections—they often lead to the most interesting results. I also recommend reviewing the garment from multiple angles and considering movement early in the process, as these aspects often reveal possibilities that static views cannot.

* * *

# See also

[**Creator's Contest 2025 Vol. 3 Fantasy Archives: Puppeteer (Tokyo Evolution)**](https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/1017be531c4349089eacb477f95400c0)**** Project and Steps by AI / Kimia
